description: List public gatherings (worship nights, prayer meetings, Bible studies, services) in one named city that start within the next few hours (default 12, up to 36; ones that started in the last hour are kept), from the public Kingdom Protocol listing, with host name, venue name and a data URL. Use for "a prayer meeting tonight in Atlanta". For a window of days, online-only, or a search by coordinates use find_gatherings_near; for a plain week use events_this_week; for live rooms in the app use tables_live_now. Matches by city name, not distance; cancelled gatherings and those whose hosts keep their location private are excluded. Times are UTC and as posted by hosts. None returns count 0. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

city.description: City name, matched as text: "Atlanta", "San Diego".

country.description: Optional country to disambiguate the city, ISO code ("US") or name.

hours.description: How many hours ahead to look, 1 to 36 (default 12).

name: gatherings_tonight

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

gatherings.description: Each gathering: id, title, start (ISO, UTC), city, region, country, online flag, host name, venue name, and its public JSON data URL.

honest.description: Present when count is 0: what the empty result means.

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

source_url.description: The first public web page this answer came from or points to.

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.

title: Gatherings tonight
